newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BOOST FOR BARCELONA AS BETIS DRAW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOOST FOR BARCELONA AS BETIS DRAW.

text.p: Barcelona saw their hopes of taking Spain's second Champions' League place boosted on Sunday when they moved two points ahead of third-placed Real Betis.

While Barcelona brushed aside Sporting Gijon 4-0, Betis conceded a late goal in the 2-2 home draw with Racing Santander. The result means that Barcelona move to within six points of leaders Real Madrid who face Compostela on Monday.
Barcelona never looked in trouble, cruising to victory with goals from Ivan de la Pena, Juan Pizzi and Brazilians Giovanni and Ronaldo.
Espanyol pulled out of the danger zone with a 1-0 win at fellow strugglers Rayo Vallecano, while Valencia crashed 4-1 at Valladolid, prompting speculation that coach Jorge Valdano could be sacked.
